hypotheses.J0_sitewise_jacobian_is_the_correct_loca: An evaluation site's small-edit Jacobian predicts its four-times-larger edits with coordinate fidelity at least 0.99 on every corpus.
hypotheses.J1_full_context_materially_improves: A rank-32 full-state context model improves at least 0.05 over the global mean Jacobian on every corpus.
hypotheses.J2_full_context_explains_transport: A rank-64 full-state context model reaches coordinate fidelity at least 0.90 on every corpus.
hypotheses.J3_full_context_explains_graph_changes: A rank-64 full-state context model reaches selected-edge-change fidelity at least 0.90 on every corpus.
hypotheses.J4_full_context_beats_late_coordinates: Rank-32 full-state context exceeds a linear model of all 32 late coordinates by at least 0.05 on every corpus.
hypotheses.J5_context_rule_transfers_ood: The best preregistered rank at or below 128 is within 0.05 of its FineWeb fidelity on both OOD corpora.
hypotheses.J6_transport_has_a_low_dimensional_conte: At least one rank at or below 128 reaches 95 percent of the gap from the global map to the sitewise oracle on every corpus.
